observations: Photo 0 shows an Xbox console with a black wireless controller placed on top; the Xbox logo is visible on the console front.
Photo 1 shows a close side view of the console with the controller in frame; no storage/model label is readable.
Photo 2 shows the console side/front with the Xbox vent grille and the Xbox logo; no 1TB marking is readable.

read_from: photo 0 (Xbox logo/One S styling visible, but storage capacity not readable)

claims.evidence: Photos show an Xbox One S-looking console, but no readable label/serial/specs confirming 1TB (photos 0-2).
A single wireless controller is shown with the console in photo 0 and photo 1.
No screen/boot-up photo showing installed games/library (photos 0-2 only show hardware).

risks.risk: Storage capacity may not be 1TB (could be 500GB/other), affecting value.
risks.proof: A photo of the console storage screen: Settings > System > Storage (show total capacity) or a clear label/serial/specs sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as the lowest likely capacity for an Xbox One S (treat as not confirmed 1TB).

risks.risk: Console may have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, controller connectivity issues). Photos can’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: A short video/clip of the console powering on to the home screen and launching a game/app (and controller pairing working).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested / worst-case: assume it may have issues until proven working.

risks.risk: Installed games may be absent, incomplete, or require licenses/accounts.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the Games & Apps library showing installed titles and that they launch from the console.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as no confirmed games installed (or treat as unknown value until titles are shown).

risks.risk: Controller condition may be poor (drift, broken buttons, worn sticks).
risks.proof: Video showing controller inputs (stick movement) and a quick test in a game/menu; close-up of sticks/buttons if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming controller may need repair/replacement (worst-case for buyer).

proof_requests: Photo of Settings > System > Storage showing total capacity (confirm 1TB).
Video of the console booting to the home screen and connecting the controller.
Photo/video of the Games & Apps library showing the installed games and that at least one launches.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One S-style console and one controller, but they do not verify the key pricing drivers: 1TB storage and whether games are actually installed/launchable. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
